snippet.title: Elemental Kin | Wuyang Hero Trailer | Overwatch 2
snippet.description:
Does Wuyang have what it takes to be a Hero and answer the call?

Join him and his older sister, Anran, as their sibling rivalry turns into a heated sparring match in our newest Hero Trailer, Elemental Kin.

And play as Wuyang when he makes his official Overwatch 2 debut in Season 18 on Aug 26.

Overwatch 2 is free to play for everyone on console & PC!

Music by CiCi Zhu
